name: io.github.rafe-walker/kronicle-lite
description: Hash-chained local document store with signed receipts and an orient protocol for stale agent memory

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_LITE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the SQLite store and keys (default ~/.kronicle-lite)

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_LITE_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: Actor id label used on cursors and writes (default local-agent)

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_ANCHOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted anchor service for checkpoint push / remote verify (default https://anchor.isokron.ai)

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_ANCHOR_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key for the hosted anchor service (only needed to push anchors)
